# OpenAPI2Code

> A zero-dependency, multi-target code generation engine that converts
> OpenAPI (3.0, 3.1) and Swagger (2.0) specs into typed models. Runs as a
> single static-binary CLI, and as a WebAssembly-powered browser playground
> that never sends the spec to a server.

OpenAPI2Code generates:
- TypeScript interfaces
- Zod runtime validation schemas
- Swift Codable structs
- Kotlin data classes
- Dart classes

All targets are generated from the same intermediate representation of the
parsed spec, so output is structurally consistent across languages. More
than one target can be generated in a single run.

## Key facts

- Free and open source (MIT license).
- The browser playground performs conversion entirely client-side (Go
  compiled to WASM) — nothing pasted or uploaded is ever sent to a server.
- The CLI is a single zero-dependency binary; prebuilt binaries are
  published for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Supports OpenAPI 3.0, OpenAPI 3.1, and Swagger 2.0, including circular
  references and allOf/oneOf/anyOf composition.

## Pages

- [Playground](https://openapi2code.com/): paste or upload a spec and generate code live, in the browser.
- [Use cases](https://openapi2code.com/use-cases.html): where OpenAPI2Code fits in a real workflow.
- [Examples](https://openapi2code.com/examples.html): sample specs and their generated output across all five targets.
- [Contact](https://openapi2code.com/contact.html): issue tracker and email contact.
- [Source code and releases](https://github.com/TarikTz/openapi2code): CLI binaries, source, and issue tracker on GitHub.
